description: This file defines the TranslationManager class, responsible for managing translation requests asynchronously in an Android application. It handles translation via a Translator interface, supports injecting mock translators for testing, and manages a coroutine scope for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: TranslationManager
classes.description: Manages asynchronous translation requests with support for dependency injection and latency updates.

classes.name: TranslationRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating information needed to perform a translation request and handle the result.

methods.name: translateAsync
methods.description: Enqueues an asynchronous translation request, invoking the callback with the result when ready.

methods.name: injectTranslator
methods.description: Replaces the current translator with a provided mock or alternative translator, useful for testing.

methods.name: updateLatency
methods.description: Updates the latency parameter which can influence the translation delay behavior.
